relevance_note: A narrative review of monogenic and PID-related causes of Behcet-like disease; HA20 is discussed only at group level ("Patients carrying HA20 present with periodic fevers, recurrent aphthous stomatitis, genital ulceration") with no individual TNFAIP3 carrier described.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand. Section 2.1 (TNFAIP3) and Table 1 describe HA20 only as a disease and at group level; no individual-level fact (sex, age, variant or feature) is given for any person with a TNFAIP3 variant, so no individual rows. Individual cases described (TNFRSF1A, LIG4, WDR1, STAT1, ADA2, AP1S3, LYN, NEMO, RELA, NFKB1, NCF1) carry variants in other genes and are out of scope. The paper gives no total number of patients and states no prior description of its own patients (it reports none first-hand), so those fields are null / not reported.

study_type.span: In this review, we summarize genetic predisposition to BD.
